name: Full Course
source:
A visual novel where you play as Morgan, socially phobic kid of a famous chef that now must go to culinary college after working in his family's restaurant for most of his life. How will he make it through while coping with his issue of seeing people as food?

[From [url=https://fullcourse.itch.io/demo] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说。你将扮演摩根：他是著名厨师的孩子，却害怕与人交往；大半辈子都在家族餐厅工作的他，如今必须进入烹饪学院学习。在把人看成食物的困扰下，他要如何坚持下去？

[来源：[url=https://fullcourse.itch.io/demo]itch.io[/url]]
